meta.question: what do the owner and the agents repeat by hand, how often, and which of it should become a reconciler, a recurring job, a CLI verb, a policy line or a Renovate-style tool

sources.owner_history: mini ~/.zsh_history and IU MacBook ~/.zsh_history (frozen aggregates, see owner_history.sources.*.status)
sources.agent_bash: ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl, 6061 files with entries in the window 2026-09-22T08:00:00.000Z .. 2026-10-22T08:00:00.000Z

definitions.month: 30 days; transcript, warden and human-queue figures use the window [AS_OF - 30 d, AS_OF)
definitions.pattern: command + subcommand with every argument elided or replaced by a placeholder (cmdnorm.normalize); env assignments, paths, URLs, quoted strings and heredoc bodies never reach an output
definitions.owner_manual: shell-history entries not typed by rd/herdr; injected lines (`export USAGE_LANE=`, `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions ...`, `claude --bg`) are counted apart
definitions.glue: cd, export, echo, set, test and other shell builtins; counted in totals, excluded from rankings
definitions.inspect: read-only inspection (ls, cat, grep, sed without -i, head, ...); ranked, but excluded from recipes and the action table
definitions.session: one Claude Code session id; subagent transcripts count with their parent
definitions.recipe: the same 3-5 consecutive non-noise patterns in >= 5 sessions (gaps over 20 min break a sequence; consecutive duplicates collapse); maximal sequences only
definitions.failing_call: tool_result with is_error and `Exit code N`, minus normal non-zero exits (grep/rg no match, test, diff, git rev-parse ...)
definitions.blocked_call: a call refused by the harness or a PreToolUse hook (sleep-then-command, worktree isolation, force push, raw docker)
definitions.retry: a failing call re-run within the next 8 calls / 15 min, as the same command (exact) or the same action-level pattern; `without edit` = no Edit/Write tool call in between
definitions.agent_step_time: seconds from a Bash call to the next Bash call in the same file (includes waiting inside the call), capped at 600 s
definitions.lane: interactive = Claude Code CLI sessions; headless = sdk-cli sessions elsewhere; agw-job / sideclaw-job = dispatched review and check workers; scratch / bench = temporary directories
definitions.warden_item: DEFINITIONS.md `item`: duplicates are occurrences, counted apart; outcomes follow `resolved`; escalated / owner_touch as defined there
definitions.warden_family: rule-based normalisation of source + title (service names, numbers, addresses and ids removed); `family_of` in toil.py
definitions.agent_job: a dispatches row linked by origin_event_id, or a job id stored on the item (dispatch, implement, validation, triage, sweep, train)
definitions.human_queue_kind: keyword classification of the ask text and proposed command (HQ_RULES in toil.py); only counts are stored

assumptions.owner_history_window_basis: zsh history here carries no per-line timestamps; the window is assumed to be ~30 days. Cross-check: injected agent launches in the retained history are of the same order as the agent sessions the transcripts show for 30 days (see owner_history.<src>.window_check).
assumptions.owner_typing_seconds: 4 + len(raw command) / 5  (typing at ~5 chars/s plus 4 s of context switch)
assumptions.agent_blocked_turn_s: measured: seconds from a blocked call to the agent's next call (capped 600 s)
assumptions.agent_retry_cycle_s: measured: seconds from a failed call to its re-run (capped 900 s)
assumptions.owner_ask_minutes_basis: ~1 min to read the macOS dialog, click Run and give Touch ID, plus ~2 min of lost focus; a failed ask is paid again as a retry ask. ran_at is stamped when the dialog is shown, so the real click latency is not recorded
assumptions.escalation_minutes_basis: read the card or Argo item, decide, answer
assumptions.agent_hour_weight_basis: an agent hour is worth a fifth of an owner hour for ranking: agents run in parallel and cost quota, the owner's attention is the scarce resource; both columns are always shown

meta.redaction: free text passes lib/redact.py:redact(); patterns carry no arguments; IuRoot repos by name only, their calls appear as tool-level aggregates

turn_time.definition: seconds from one Bash call to the next call in the same transcript file, capped at 600 s

candidates.pattern: Monitor and container outage items (Kuma down, uk monitor, unhealthy container, watchdog, job failure): one item and one investigation per page
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (level-triggered conditions) + correlation (topology / 15-min window fold: one outage = one incident)
candidates.arithmetic: owner: 37 escalations x 6 min x 70 % / 60; agent: 72 job-min x 70 % / 60
candidates.note: 70 % folded is an assumption (the 10-17 outage folds 16 pages into 1)

candidates.pattern: Escalations (`needs_decision`) raised on intake items, the owner's and agents' own briefs and issues
candidates.mechanism: policy line (the fixed owner-decision rule: product direction, spend, irreversible data loss, other people) + verification ladder (everything else is decided on evidence)
candidates.arithmetic: 54 escalations x 6 min x 50 % not a genuine owner decision / 60
candidates.note: 50 % is a placeholder until the golden set labels `genuine_owner_decision`; replace it with the measured share

candidates.pattern: `claude --resume <session id>` typed by hand (find the id, paste)
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (herdr restores the agents that were running after a crash or reboot) + CLI verb (`rd resume <repo>`)
candidates.arithmetic: 123 resumes x 45 s / 3600
candidates.note: 45 s per resume is an assumption

candidates.pattern: Hermes log lines opened as items (tool errors, checkpoint-manager git skips, streaming failures, second gateway instance)
candidates.mechanism: known-error store (fix once, recognise the fingerprint) + policy line (expected skips are logged below ERROR)
candidates.arithmetic: owner: 14 touches x 6 min x 80 % / 60; agent: 147 job-min x 80 % / 60

candidates.pattern: 1Password item writes via the human-queue (op item create/edit/rename); stdin read as a JSON template
candidates.mechanism: CLI verb (`secrets put|rename`, JSON-safe, idempotent) + policy line (never pipe JSON into `op item create`)
candidates.arithmetic: 10 failed asks x 2 asks (the failed one and its retry) x 3 min / 60

candidates.pattern: Orchestrators polling agent and PR state (`rd agents`, `rd read`, wave-watch, `herdr agent wait|list|get`, `gh pr checks`)
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (event log + push: a finished wave or red check wakes the orchestrator)

candidates.pattern: 1Password lookups (item titles / field names, no values)
candidates.mechanism: CLI verb (`secrets ls` answering from the sealed cache, no dialog)
candidates.arithmetic: 15 asks x 3 min x 100 % / 60

candidates.pattern: Push the tailnet ACL from the private repo (diff, confirm, apply); guard aborts and retries
candidates.mechanism: Renovate-style tool (GitOps: verify on PR, apply on merge, drift check)
candidates.arithmetic: 12 asks x 3 min x 100 % / 60

candidates.pattern: `sleep <n>` polls for a job, CI run or service (one model turn per poll)
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (event-driven wake: herdr events and job completion push to the waiting agent)
candidates.arithmetic: 2035 polls x 80 % x 5.9 s median turn / 3600 (the waiting itself is not claimed)
candidates.note: 80 % is an assumption; some sleeps are legitimate pacing

candidates.pattern: Reseal the mini secrets cache after `headless.refs` changed
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (refs file = desired, sealed cache = observed; one batched approval instead of one per change)
candidates.arithmetic: 14 asks x 3 min x 70 % batched away / 60

candidates.pattern: Verification run as separate calls in a row (`bun test`, `bunx oxfmt`, typecheck, lint, build)
candidates.mechanism: CLI verb + policy line (one `make check` per repo, the same entrypoint everywhere)
candidates.arithmetic: 1677 extra calls x 70 % x 5.9 s / 3600

candidates.pattern: Scheduled-job alerts as GitHub issues (store_stale, workflow_failed, job_down, disk_low): an item and an investigation each time
candidates.mechanism: recurring job (per-signal self-heal with the fix recipe in the known-error store)
candidates.arithmetic: owner: 5 touches x 6 min x 60 % / 60; agent: 29 job-min x 60 % / 60

candidates.pattern: Estate chores that need a present human (sudo cleanups, TCC / Full Disk Access grants, host installs, token pages)
candidates.mechanism: recurring job (monthly estate sweep, one batched approval) + policy line (grant TCC once per machine)
candidates.arithmetic: 14 asks x 3 min x 50 % batched or granted once / 60

candidates.pattern: `reset` typed after a Claude launcher exits (terminal left in a bad state)
candidates.frequency_30d: 337 resets / month, 258 directly after a launcher
candidates.mechanism: policy line in the launcher (`c` restores the TTY on exit)
candidates.arithmetic: 337 resets x 3 s / 3600
candidates.note: 3 s per reset is an assumption

candidates.pattern: Process cleanup recipe `kill -> sleep -> kill -> rm` (stale dev / test servers and lockfiles)
candidates.mechanism: recurring job (reaper for stale agent-owned processes and locks) + CLI verb (`rd kill-tree`)
candidates.arithmetic: 1031 calls x 80 % x 5.9 s / 3600 (upper bound, whole step time: 10.35 h)
candidates.note: 80 % is an assumption; each recipe is one chained call, so a verb alone saves tokens, the reaper saves the call

candidates.pattern: Local health probes by hand (`curl localhost:<port>/health`)
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (health probes declared in the project manifest, state read from the event log)

candidates.pattern: `sleep N && <command>` polling that the harness blocks, then re-issued differently
candidates.mechanism: policy line (wait with `rd wait` / `agw wait` / Monitor, never `sleep N &&`)
candidates.arithmetic: 515 blocked calls x 100 % x 5.9 s median turn / 3600 (measured time to the next call, an upper bound: 6.22 h)

candidates.pattern: GNU-isms on macOS: `sed -i` / `sed` syntax errors, unquoted zsh globs, `head -n -N`, GNU-only flags
candidates.mechanism: policy line (BSD userland: `sed -i ''`, quote globs; prefer the Edit tool) + PreToolUse rewrite
candidates.arithmetic: 530 failing calls x 90 % x 5.9 s / 3600 (upper bound, measured step time: 1.65 h)

candidates.pattern: Commands refused by the worktree-isolation guard and by the git / docker hooks (force push, protected branch, raw docker)
candidates.mechanism: policy line (AGENTS.md: what stays inside a worktree; merge only via `rd merge` / PR)
candidates.arithmetic: 493 blocked calls x 80 % x 5.9 s / 3600 (upper bound, measured: 1.00 h)

candidates.pattern: Container inspection on the VPS and homelab by hand (`ssh <host>: docker ps|logs|exec|inspect`)
candidates.mechanism: CLI verb (`vps|hl ps|logs`) or an Argo read model

candidates.pattern: git add / commit / push / `gh pr create` issued as separate calls in a row
candidates.mechanism: CLI verb (`git ship`; the `/commit` skill as the only way)
candidates.arithmetic: 229 extra calls x 90 % x 5.9 s / 3600
candidates.note: 90 % is an assumption; most commit recipes are already one chained call (median 1), only the separate ones count

candidates.pattern: launchd inspection and restarts by hand (`launchctl print|list|kickstart`)
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (desired launchd jobs from the manifest, kickstart when unhealthy)

candidates.pattern: Dependency checks and bumps by agents (`bun outdated|update`, `npm outdated`, `ncu`, `uv lock`, `brew outdated|upgrade`)
candidates.mechanism: Renovate-style tool (mechanical bumps as PRs; agents only for breaking changes)

candidates.pattern: Recovery notifications opened as items (Kuma up, status-page opened / auto-resolved) and closed `ignored`
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (an `up` event closes the matching condition and never creates an item)
candidates.arithmetic: 32 items, no agent job, no owner touch: noise removed, hours measured = 0 job-min / 60
candidates.note: pure ledger and card churn; hours are ~0 by measurement

candidates.pattern: Shell polling loops (`until|while|for ... sleep`) that park a session in one long call
candidates.frequency_30d: 2516 loops in 558 sessions, 71.9 h of wall time
candidates.mechanism: reconciler (event-driven wake frees the session; no turns removed, so no hours claimed)
candidates.arithmetic: each loop is one call: turns removed = 0; wall time parked = 71.9 h (not claimed)
candidates.note: listed so the omission is visible; latency and parallelism gain, not toil hours
